plan.title: Close-out rejects comment-posted review verdicts that the merge door accepts (DoD row 1 reads only reviewDecision)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Close-out DoD row 1 (checkVerdict review branch in src/lib/lifecycle/dod-gate.ts, line ~438) passes only on the raw PR's reviewDecision === 'APPROVED'. When the review agent cannot submit a formal GitHub review it posts '<!-- overdeck-verdict: APPROVED sha=<head> -->' as a comment. The merge gate reads that comment through getPrFacts (approvedAtHead) and merges, but row 1 still misses ('PR #12 reviewDecision: ; MISS' for OKF-11), so the Flywheel needs the operator-only --accept-review override for a review that really passed.
narratives.Proposal: When the raw reviewDecision is neither APPROVED nor CHANGES_REQUESTED and some comment carries a verdict marker, row 1 runs the PR it already read through the merge gate's reader — getPrFacts(issueId, { fetchGitHubPr: async () => ({ issueId, pr }) }) — and passes when approvalProvenAtHead(facts) is true (trusted APPROVED marker whose sha= names the head). The reader is injected as an optional DodStatusRowDeps.readReviewFacts dep. A newest trusted CHANGES_REQUESTED comment (facts.changesRequested) is a negative verdict like a forge CHANGES_REQUESTED: no strike skip, no settlement skip, miss. A failed read appends 'review verdict comment unreadable: <error>' to observed and falls through to today's strike/settlement/miss logic. A null or empty reviewDecision renders as 'none'. pr-facts.ts is not changed (991/1000 lines). Docs: dod.ts row 1 expected text, a docs/MERGE-WORKFLOW.md paragraph, and changelog.d/pan-5401.md. Full detail with before/after code is in .pan/drafts/PAN-5401.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Row 1 must not read the pipeline journal's review.verdict entry.
- Row 6 (main-verify) required-check defaults for non-Overdeck projects are not changed.
- No line is added to or removed from src/lib/cloister/pr-facts.ts; the merge gate, getPrFacts, and marker trust rules are not changed.
- Rows 2-9 and the --accept-* flags are not changed.
- GitLab row 1 behavior (forgeMerge landing path) is not changed.
- No second verdict parser or regex is written.

autoDecisions.summary: Accept only the PR comment marker evidence (approvalProvenAtHead via getPrFacts); do not read the pipeline journal.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue offered the journal as an alternative, but the merge gate does not read it and CLAUDE.md makes the journal never authority; matching the merge gate's evidence exactly is the fix.

autoDecisions.summary: Reuse the reader by calling getPrFacts with an injected fetchGitHubPr that returns the PR row 1 already read, instead of exporting a new helper from pr-facts.ts.
autoDecisions.rationale: pr-facts.ts is 991 lines against the 1000-line file-size ceiling with no allowlist row; injected deps also bypass the PR-facts cache and avoid a second gh call.

autoDecisions.summary: A newest trusted CHANGES_REQUESTED verdict comment is row 1's negative verdict (revised after plan critique round 1).
autoDecisions.rationale: Row 1 claims the merge gate's evidence, and the merge gate refuses a PR whose newest trusted marker requests changes; letting settlement or the strike path skip it would close out rejected work.

autoDecisions.summary: A failed verdict read falls through to today's row logic with the error appended to observed, rather than failing closed.
autoDecisions.rationale: The marker read only adds evidence; today's behavior is the floor. The PR-read failure path (PAN-4821) still fails closed because it runs earlier.

autoDecisions.summary: Row 6 required-checks follow-up from the issue is out of scope.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue labels it a follow-up worth considering and says okf's config was already fixed.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-1 (.pan/drafts/PAN-5401.md) exactly. In src/lib/lifecycle/dod-gate.ts: import approvalProvenAtHead, getPrFacts, parseVerdictMarker and type PrFacts from '../cloister/pr-facts.js'; add optional readReviewFacts?: (issueId, pr: IssuePullRequestData) => Promise<PrFacts> to DodStatusRowDeps; add readReviewFactsFromPr(issueId, pr) = getPrFacts(issueId, { fetchGitHubPr: async () => ({ issueId, pr }) }) and set it as defaultDeps.readReviewFacts; add commentApprovalAtHead(issueId, pr, deps) that returns not-approved without any read unless some comment's parseVerdictMarker(body) !== null (APPROVED or CHANGES_REQUESTED), then passes only when approvalProvenAtHead(facts) && facts.headSha, and reports facts.error or a thrown error as note 'review verdict comment unreadable: <message>'. In the checkVerdict review block change `pr.reviewDecision ?? 'none'` to `pr.reviewDecision || 'none'`, make observed a let, and when decision is neither APPROVED nor CHANGES_REQUESTED call commentApprovalAtHead: on approval return pass with observed `${observed}; Overdeck verdict comment approved head ${head.slice(0, 12)}`, else append the note (if any) and continue to the unchanged strike/settlement/miss logic. Never use facts.approved or facts.reviewDecision as the pass predicate. Add tests/unit/lib/lifecycle/dod-gate-review-marker.test.ts with tests T1-T5 as named in the PRD, mocking '../../../../src/lib/github-app-installations.js' appCoversRepo to false and injecting readReviewFacts built from the real getPrFacts with fetchGitHubPr and isAppConfigured: () => false injected. T5 must use T1's PR fixture so the APPROVED-marker guard lets the read run, with readReviewFacts resolving emptyPrFacts(id, 'boom'). Do not modify src/lib/cloister/pr-facts.ts or the existing dod-gate.test.ts.

items.title: Given a merged PR with reviewDecision '' and a trusted OWNER comment '<!-- overdeck-verdict: APPROVED sha=<head> -->' newer than the head commit, when checkReviewRow runs, then it returns status 'pass' with observed 'PR #12 reviewDecision: none; Overdeck verdict comment approved head <first 12 hex of head>' (test T1).
Given the same PR but the APPROVED comment's sha= names a different commit, when checkReviewRow runs, then it returns status 'miss' with observed exactly 'PR #12 reviewDecision: none' (test T2).

Given no comment whose first line is a verdict marker, or a forge reviewDecision of APPROVED or CHANGES_REQUESTED, when checkReviewRow runs, then the injected readReviewFacts mock is never called, forge APPROVED returns 'pass', and forge CHANGES_REQUESTED with a head-matching APPROVED comment returns 'miss' (tests T3, T4).

Given T1's PR (head-matching APPROVED comment present) and readReviewFacts resolving emptyPrFacts(id, 'boom') or throwing Error('gh down'), when checkReviewRow runs, then it returns 'miss' with observed ending 'review verdict comment unreadable: boom' / '... gh down', and on a strike landing it returns 'skip' (test T5).

git diff --stat origin/main...HEAD -- src/lib/cloister/pr-facts.ts prints nothing, npm run lint:file-size and npm run lint:circular exit 0, and the unchanged tests/unit/lib/lifecycle/dod-gate.test.ts passes with its existing observed-string assertions.
